mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different pathways (baclofen via GABA-B agonism, perphenazine via dopamine antagonism and anticholinergic effects), with additive sedation and psychomotor impairment.
action: Monitor for enhanced CNS depression including sedation, dizziness, and impaired coordination; counsel patient to avoid concurrent alcohol and use caution with activities requiring alertness; consider dose adjustments if excessive CNS effects occur.
